subject: 20 Year Old Who Chose Not to Raise
body:
Hi Christina,

I'm Max, 20, an applied math sophomore. I built an AI teaching assistant and turned down money for it, because I did not have conviction in the idea, and I am still looking for the one I will. Waiting until $10M ARR to raise, ten times the usual threshold, is buying the right to be wrong in private.

I'd love to know whether the conviction was there before you refused the round, or whether refusing created it. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Cold Called My Way Through College
body:
Hi Clem,

I'm Max, 20, studying applied math. I built an AI teaching assistant, won $5K for it in a pitch competition, and made $30k cold calling small businesses to pay for school.

Building UniShared for students and then taking four years of product jobs at other people's companies before founding again is the rare case where the thesis outlived the product.

I'd love to know what those four years gave you that founding again immediately would not have.

If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max

subject: Building an AI Teaching Assistant at 20
body:
Hi Eric,

I'm Max, 20, a sophomore studying applied math, and I built an AI teaching assistant that starts piloting in a school this fall. Going from lesson plans for teachers to teaching people to code to just handing them the machine is a career of deciding the tool matters more than the lesson.

I'd love to know what ClassConnect taught you about selling to teachers, because that is the wall I expect to hit first. If you're open to 10 minutes, I promise I'll pay it forward.

Best,
Max
